fire_when: A proof passes from finite Gaussian path soft-minima to a growing-network normalized endpoint limit using only beta_n->infinity.
silent_when: A fixed finite path family is kept fixed during beta->infinity, or a uniform entropy/error bound is already supplied.
text: Before a growing-path soft-min limit, bound log|P_n|/(beta_n L_n) or a sharper entropy error. The C526.6 control has v_n=L_n=n and beta_n=n yet hard and soft endpoint limits differ by log 2. This is a draft lead; check its premises.
